title: GuGuGaGa infinite wins & cash
script:
-- script REQUIRES replicatesignal & unrestricted raknet is recommended but optional
-- NOTICE: raknet can be EXTREMELY dangerous(DTC) so use with care
local Config = {
	TargetWins = 4206967,
	UseRaknet = true
}

local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer

if Config.UseRaknet then

	-- catch and save packet so we can cheaply send it in bulk
	local pktData = {}
	raknet.hook_out(function(p)
		if p.PacketId ~= 0x83 then return end
		local parsed = raknet.parse(p)
		for _, item in next, parsed.items do
			if item.name == "MouseButton1Down" then
				table.insert(pktData, buffer.tostring(p:AsBuffer()))
				table.insert(pktData, p.Priority)
				table.insert(pktData, p.Reliability)
				table.insert(pktData, p.OrderingChannel)
			end
		end
	end)

	local claim = lp.PlayerGui.UI.Restart.WinFrame.Claim
	replicatesignal(claim.MouseButton1Down, 0, 0)
	repeat task.wait() until #pktData == 4 -- wait til packet caught

	-- send alot of clones
	-- i +2 to make up for the replicatesignal
	for i=lp.leaderstats.Wins.Value+2, Config.TargetWins do
		raknet.send(unpack(pktData))
	end

else

	local claim = lp.PlayerGui.UI.Restart.WinFrame.Claim
	for i=lp.leaderstats.Wins.Value+1, Config.TargetWins do
		replicatesignal(claim.MouseButton1Down, 0, 0)
	end

end
